limits: Scene-paired repeated measures: routes and levels live on the same scenes and add no independent N. Intervals are cluster-bootstrap envelopes over three seeds at the family and template levels; seeds are not model replications. The L=255 and no-message rows are structural zeros of four-answer success for a deterministic receiver, not evidence about communication. Complete facts only (no sender). The bank is finite and constructed; the default evaluation set is a pre-declared balanced subset of it.
